scripts.build:staging: pnpm --filter app build:staging && pnpm --filter web build:staging
scripts.test:emulators: pnpm --filter functions build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project sathiya-lk "pnpm --filter functions --if-present test && pnpm --filter rules --if-present test"
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter functions build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project sathiya-lk "pnpm --filter e2e test"
